text:
Hector (AE): Quick heads-up 1 HaloMed POC is moving to procurement. They want invoices split by legal entity (HaloMed US / HaloMed EU SARL / HaloMed Labs UK), separate PO numbers, and AP signers for each entity. They also attached a DPA redline demanding HSM for hosted and 72h incident notification. Can we support multi-entity invoices + delegated signers?

procurement_halo: Hi team 1 AP can sign for speed. We need separate PDF invoices, VAT reverse-charge handling for EU, and key custody assurances. Also, are signer emails acceptable instead of full exec countersign?

Nina (Legal): AP delegation is fine with a short attestation (name, title, email, statement they can bind the entity). HSM-for-hosted is a product escalation; our standard: HSM only for Private/Dedicated. For Hosted we can offer KMS attestation + SOC2 and pen-test summary. 72h notification is tight; propose "reasonable efforts" + confirm within 72h after incident validation. Also flag: DPA asks for 30-day deletion of backups 1 we need to counter with 90-day retention plus documented purge steps.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Tech-wise we can attach billing_entity and signer metadata to the OF payload and route invoices. Suggested OF snippet: 
```billing_entity: halo-eu-sarl
po_number: HL-EU-0007
vat_number: FRNL123456
signer_email: ap-eu@halomed.fr
```
Fallback: route to parent-finance if mapping missing. If they insist on HSM in hosted, that'll require Private deployment and adds time/cost.

Grace (Finance): Separate invoices per legal entity required for tax reporting. Need tax IDs, remit addresses, and VAT validation before invoicing. Net terms: they requested net30; finance can approve after credit check. For POC, if split entities are unvetted we may require CC on file or prepay first invoice. Separate Stripe/AR accounts will be created for each entity.

Anya (Security): Regarding HSM ask: we can provide KMS attestation and architecture diagrams for Hosted customers. Dedicated HSM custody is only in Private/Dedicated offerings. We'll attach the KMS whitepaper and latest pen-test excerpt. Also note: Hosted does not support key export.

contracts-bot: Uploaded: Halo_DPA_redline_v2.docx (link)

procurement_halo: Thanks. AP can sign and we'll provide attestations. We prefer separate PDFs per entity. Also asking if liability cap can be set to 12 months fees.

Nina (Legal): We'll counter with liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months or $250k floor, whichever is greater. We'll draft a one-line attestation clause for AP signers and push back on HSM-for-hosted language.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll post a sample OF JSON and a sample invoice mapping this afternoon. It will include fields: billing_entity_id, po_number, signer_email, remit_address_id.

Grace (Finance): Confirming: separate invoice PDFs, unique invoice numbers per entity, VAT reverse-charge validation required, remit addresses needed before first invoice.

Hector (AE): Great 1 I'll collect tax IDs, remit addresses, and the signed AP attestations and post here. Procurement 1 please send any additional redlines. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
